artifact_provenance.reason: runtime sidecar binary release evidence is generated by the updated GitHub Actions workflow on the next pushed commit; production allowlist promotion still requires deployment-controlled checksum and Cargo.lock digest approval

benchmark_report.reason: requires real Python baseline vs Rust sidecar baseline covering task submit, node transition, task edge save, artifact metadata save, event append, lease, event replay, and SSE snapshot

promotion_readiness.reason: requires 7 consecutive days and at least 1000 production shadow samples with zero contract mismatch, panic, and crash

migration_plan.reason: requires deployment migration/DR dry-run evidence, backup, restore, replay validation, rollback, and roll-forward drill records

ops_readiness.reason: requires dashboard, alert, SLO, runbook execution, and fault-drill records for enforce rollout

decommission_readiness.reason: requires canonical sidecar stability and removal of Python storage/dispatcher write paths after promotion
